name: order_mean_read
purpose: TASKS 238 (from 230, 240; the audit's W1-W3, probes/results_m1/aromir_audit_2026-11-16/AUDIT.md), 16 Nov 2026: does the mean of the release's seed-mean dH over K presentations of one molecule (another atom order, a rigid rotation, the mirror image; mapped back to the stored frame and order) make the corrected band positions better, or only stable? Hold-outs (a) 8 and (b) 39 molecules plus benzonitrile A_3100da3761 as a labelled case outside the pooled numbers, on stored B3LYP and wB97X analytic Hessians, K = 1, 4, 16, 64, two independent K-sets per molecule, four kinds of presentation (uniform permutations; rotation + mirror; both; the front door's canonical order of a shuffled xyz listing with rotation + mirror). Inference only, no quantum chemistry. In WSL with the fixed snapshot ~/aromir_v13 (aromir bd2b0e5, non-editable, bundled release v1.3). The script first checks the round trip of the mapping on benzene (1e-12) and that the stored presentation reproduces the product's error of probes/results_m1/aromir_product_error_2026-11-16 to 0.01 cm-1, and stops otherwise. Writes order_mean.json and order_mean.txt beside the script.
command: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl -e bash -c "export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONUTF8=1; cd /mnt/c/Users/thebr/Documents/CapstonePlan/plans/05_delta-probed-ir-pipeline && echo '=== (ORDERMEAN) start' && bash probes/wsl_capped.sh 1024 -- /usr/bin/time -f '(ORDERMEAN) max RSS %M kB, wall %e s' /home/thebreadishard/aromir_v13/bin/python probes/results_m1/order_mean_2026-11-16/order_mean.py . probes/results_m1/order_mean_2026-11-16 && echo '=== (ORDERMEAN) done'"

estimate.basis: the first launch of 16 Nov 2026 18:49 read 35 of 48 molecules in 105 min and stopped on a shuffled xyz listing aromir's front door refused (since then: a refused listing is redrawn and counted, every presentation is drawn before the first network call, each molecule's reads are kept in order_mean_partial/ and a relaunch reads only what is missing). Before it:the script's smoke on 16 Nov 2026 (3 molecules, K up to 4, the same two one-thread processes under the same cap): 0.40 s per correction of three seeds (median; 0.69 s for a 29-atom molecule); the read makes 48 molecules x 4 kinds x 2 sets x 64 = 24,576 corrections, two side by side

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run at 1024 MB.
